facts.summary: Missed symptom co-primary endpoints despite histology success · Phase 3 and Phase 2/3 · lirentelimab in eosinophilic GI diseases · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Both ENIGMA 2 and KRYPTOS studies met their histologic co-primary endpoints, but did not achieve statistical significance on the patient reported symptomatic co-primary endpoints.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Lirentelimab met histologic co-primary endpoints but missed symptomatic co-primary endpoints in both ENIGMA and KRYPTOS studies
evidence.safety: The safety results of the trial were generally consistent with previously reported lirentelimab studies. No new safety signals were observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: At present we intend to continue our development efforts with subcutaneous lirentelimab in atopic dermatitis, chronic spontaneous urticaria, and asthma.
